evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Frames operational safety and capability as dependent on active rehearsal and proven readiness.

mints.name: RehearsedReadinessAsCapability
mints.title: A rollback we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have
mints.frame: Does this expression treat unverified capability as non-existent and mandate recurring operational drill to guarantee safety?
